art_direction: 略不齐的长叶眼向右望，一侧上缘稍平，留白是胖逗号形。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Make two long leaf-like eyes, one with a flatter upper segment and the other with a gently bulging arch. Keep their difference modest. Both heavy pupils look right, carrying broad comma-shaped paper reserves with blunt tips. The upper marker masses connect to the pupils; the lower contours remain short and light. Leave flat iris slivers toward the left ends. Let one outer corner rise only a little. The pair suggests someone who has understood a joke. No brows or mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
